title: Whole system crash when Android SDK configured on Linux
body: ### Tested versions tested in 4.3, 4.5, 4.6 both from the flatpak and from the page ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.99 GiB memory ### Issue description it started with me making a flappy bird clone, i finished a working prototipe but sometimes the program would hang, this happened more and more while i was trying to make it exportable to android, even when i downloaded the java sdk for fedora it messed up so much i can crash my whole system by opening the project and leaving it for some seconds, i cant even go out of it no keyboard or mouse response even background audio loops i tried compatibility mobile and forward, also prefering wayland or not, with 590 drivers or the installed 580 oficial from rpm fusion, i even disabled multiple window mode and tried to open in opengl, im very close to just change my distro entirely because i cant find a way to use godot, for whats worth i think the 590.48 drivers let me open it for longer somehow but still ### Steps to reproduce - install the latest android studio and install the templates - be sure to connect the java sdk in the settings (i used /lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk/ ) - have chrome opened (installed from terminal sudo dnf install google-chrome-stable ) - leave it open and voilá - ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) this freezes my system in like 10 seconds [test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25140843/test.zip) ok i tried making a new file and left it and still...
